body.p: By this Response, claims 1, 3-8, 10-16, and 23-28 are currently pending in this
application, wherein claims 2, 9, 17-22, and 29-73 were previously cancelled. No new matter is introduced.
The Restriction/Election Requirement alleges that this application contains claims directed to the following patentably distinct species:
I. Shelf duration; II. Wear duration.

Applicant respectfully submits that the election of species is improper, at least because the shelf duration and wear duration are not mutually exclusive as alleged by the Office Action. Indeed, the Published Application includes "[n]umerous examples of algorithms and methods for performing variations of one or both of these compensations [shelf duration and wear duration] are provided." Published Application [0007]. For example, in paragraph [0069] of the Published Application, the specification recites an embodiment including both durations. See Published Application [0069] ("[A] modified form of (1) that accounts for both shelf duration and wear duration is as follows . ..") Thus, Applicant respectfully traverses the election of species.

Alternatively, to expedite prosecution, Applicant provisionally elects, Specie I directed to the shelf duration, including claims 1, 3-8, 10, 11 and 23-28, for further prosecution, pursuant to § MPEP 818.03. Applicant reserves the right to rejoin the non-elected claims upon allowance of the elected claims and/or to pursue the subject matter of the non-elected claims via separate prosecution.

On the basis of the foregoing amendments and remarks, Applicant respectfully submits that the pending claims of this application are in condition for allowance. Favorable consideration and timely allowance of this application are respectfully requested.
Applicant invites the Examiner to contact the Applicant's Attorney if questions arise concerning this Response.
